native_findings.title: Purpose and lifecycle use cases
native_findings.native_meaning: Process-device information spans identification, diagnostic information, process values and configuration. Telemetric and asset-management use cases motivate the model; a use-case listing does not establish that every operation has a detailed mandatory field or is implemented.
native_findings.standing: Descriptive scope/use-case intent
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Dictionary identity and definition authority
native_findings.native_meaning: Semantic dictionary references identify device classes and properties; referenced dictionary definitions govern their meaning. Display names are constrained by the specified dictionary naming rules, rather than being interchangeable with semantic identifiers.
native_findings.standing: Normative definition and naming constraints; external dictionary entries not yet read
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Semantic references on instances
native_findings.native_meaning: The text requires dictionary references from types, supertypes and instance declarations to survive instantiation and overriding. It explicitly notes that non-hierarchical references are not automatically created by ordinary model instantiation.
native_findings.standing: Normative obligation plus explanatory implementation warning; no implementation claim
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Physical device, modular subdevices and multiple representations
native_findings.native_meaning: The base device combines administration, signal and inherited health interfaces and allows modular subdevices. Separate companion representations can refer to the same real-world device; neither an interface nor a second representation automatically denotes another physical asset.
native_findings.standing: Descriptive model structure and cross-specification guidance; detailed member review pending
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Analyser devices and analytical signals
native_findings.native_meaning: The source distinguishes process-analyser device types from associated analytical signal types and interfaces. Their exact content and applicability remain to be reviewed; type-name enumeration does not itself justify additional master rows.
native_findings.standing: Descriptive overview; figures and specialized type definitions unreviewed
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Optional provision with defined behavior
native_findings.native_meaning: Mandatory functionality is required; optional functionality may be absent, but provision of it entails the specified behavior. Optionality does not mean vendor-defined semantics or evidence of installed capability.
native_findings.standing: Normative applicability constraint
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Default units
native_findings.native_meaning: The source recommends the primary IEC dictionary unit as the default and permits modification where applicable. Preserve the difference between a recommended default, permitted modification and a universal mandatory unit.
native_findings.standing: Recommendation and permission; dictionary unit definitions pending
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read
native_findings.supporting_interpretation: Separate dictionary primary units, model defaults and mandated field encodings: duration hours versus encoded milliseconds; volume pulse cubic metres versus specified litres; pH sensing impedance megaohms versus default ohms. Convert magnitudes explicitly; do not infer incompatibility merely from unit labels.

native_findings.title: Inherited Devices version boundary
native_findings.native_meaning: The pinned PA-DIM model declares Devices 1.04.0 and OPC UA core 1.05.02, while the separately completed Devices donor review used 1.05.0. Inherited facts require edition-qualified tracing; they are not automatically new PA-DIM contributions or wholesale imports from the later Devices assessment.
native_findings.standing: Machine-readable dependency declaration and research constraint
native_findings.contact: Pinned model metadata read

native_findings.title: Inherited identification with stronger requirements
native_findings.native_meaning: PA-DIM makes selected inherited manufacturer/model/serial/product/revision/instance/tag facts mandatory and narrows device-revision representation. Inheritance does not mean the constraints are unchanged or that every Devices feature is included.
native_findings.standing: Normative type declarations and constraints
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Local display language and parameter-change time
native_findings.native_meaning: Local display language is distinct from client locale. DateOfLastChange concerns the last device-parameter change and is timestamped in the OPC UA Server; it is not automatically a physical-event time or a complete audit history.
native_findings.standing: Optional properties with source-specific time rule
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Identified measurement/control points and signal containers
native_findings.native_meaning: SignalTag identifies a measuring or control point. SignalSet contains SignalType instances; signal identity, process-value representation and device identity must remain distinct.
native_findings.standing: Normative object structure; SignalTag mandatory
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Condition subjects and component scope
native_findings.native_meaning: Separate device, device-component and signal condition containers attach condition information to the correct subject. A temperature at an internal component location is not automatically the environmental process quantity being measured.
native_findings.standing: Optional condition structures; specific subject qualification
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Reported, actual and simulated values
native_findings.native_meaning: Reported Value may select a simulated value while ActualValue retains the unsimulated process value. Preserve ActualValue, SimulationValue and SimulationState separately, with common engineering units in the analog definition.
native_findings.standing: Optional simulation components; explicit source semantics
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Signal damping time constant
native_findings.native_meaning: Damping is a time in seconds with a first-order 63.2-percent response meaning. It is not simply reporting interval, latency or sample frequency.
native_findings.standing: Optional parameter; borrowed dictionary definition as reproduced in PA-DIM
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Signal-scoped calibration records
native_findings.native_meaning: CalibrationTimestamp identifies calibration of a measurement channel; TypeOfCalibration identifies purpose, and repeated calibration containers can belong to one signal. These are not merely a current calibrating Boolean or success result.
native_findings.standing: Optional fields and optional placeholder containers
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Calibration points and measurand-dependent meanings
native_findings.native_meaning: Calibration point sets can contain optional input-setpoint and actual-readout components. Their dictionary identities depend on the kind of analytical measurement; do not require both optional values or impose one global calibration quantity.
native_findings.standing: Optional components; normative selection of applicable dictionary entries
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Calibration characteristics by sensing technique
native_findings.native_meaning: Cell constant, sensor slope, zero point and pH asymmetry potential preserve technique-specific meanings. Several reflect the last calibration rather than current live readings. Do not equate differently dimensioned slopes or every zero-point definition.
native_findings.standing: Optional technique-specific properties; external dictionary originals not independently read
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review
native_findings.additional_interpretation: Catalytic SensorValue (called SensingValue in explanatory prose) is bridge voltage at calibration, not an unqualified live signal. PA-Q007 retains the undefined specialized calibration-interface reference.

native_findings.title: Calibration conditions and measured response
native_findings.native_meaning: Absolute air pressure during the last calibration and t90 determined by that calibration describe calibration circumstances and response, not current ambient pressure or a generic nominal response specification.
native_findings.standing: Optional calibration evidence
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Segmented chromatograph calibration
native_findings.native_meaning: Three named ranges associate response factors with lower and upper concentration boundaries. Preserve range-specific factor associations rather than flattening to one coefficient or process operating range.
native_findings.standing: Optional range groups
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Degradation indicator versus remaining time
native_findings.native_meaning: ResidualLife and related device/component/source indicators describe degradation on a 1-good to 0-bad scale. Residual sensitivity may be calculated during calibration. Neither name establishes an estimated remaining time, a maintenance guarantee or interchangeable measurement basis.
native_findings.standing: Defined condition indicators; infrared prose/model conflict retained
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Auxiliary supply, sample-path and sensing conditions
native_findings.native_meaning: Auxiliary gas supply, sample gas/liquid flow, sample/sensor/reactor/cooler/laser temperatures, pressures and reagent levels refer to distinct subjects. Requested reference injection volume differs from actual injected volume; condition measurements are not automatically primary process outputs.
native_findings.standing: Optional technique-specific condition variables; additional default/reference tables pending
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review
native_findings.additional_interpretation: RelativeGasFlowRate is a0–100 good/bad condition measure, not an absolute volumetric flow. Sensing and reference impedances are temperature-compensated to25°C in the pH definitions.

native_findings.title: Technique-specific signal quality and residuals
native_findings.native_meaning: Baseline noise, signal-to-noise ratio, fit correlation, transmission ratio, Mahalanobis distance, spectral residual and electronic read noise are different diagnostics. Keep each basis and technique; do not turn all into an unqualified confidence score.
native_findings.standing: Optional diagnostics; complete encoding/default reconciliation pending
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Cleaning and sterilization histories
native_findings.native_meaning: Counters record sensor cleaning-in-place and sterilization-in-place events separately. They are not generic transitions into active operation, elapsed use or proof of successful maintenance.
native_findings.standing: Optional event counters
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Fixed and dynamic next-calibration intervals
native_findings.native_meaning: Some families provide a combined next-calibration interval; others distinguish configured-interval calculations from estimates based on operational/history information. Preserve basis and units; these values are not the latest calibration timestamp or a guarantee.
native_findings.standing: Optional scheduling/estimation information
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Exposure consumption and overload history
native_findings.native_meaning: Accumulated gas dosage, extrapolated peak concentration on overload and accumulated overload duration answer different questions from operating time and present concentration. Keep dosage dimensions and extrapolated versus directly measured standing.
native_findings.standing: Optional stress/exposure variables
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Chromatogram features and sample-event timing
native_findings.native_meaning: Per-signal peak width/height/area/tailing, expected versus actual retention time, injection timestamp and medium name differ from device-wide total peak area or baseline noise. Retention duration is not the injection timestamp.
native_findings.standing: Optional analytical feature and event context
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review
native_findings.additional_interpretation: ValveSwitchingCyclesCounter counts valve opening/closing operations and is an array alongside ValveName. Do not assert pairing cardinality or ordering beyond evidence actually read.

native_findings.title: Diagnostic function existence and storage capacity
native_findings.native_meaning: Watchdog describes existence of a fault-detection function, not a live heartbeat or observed successful test. RemainingDataStorageCapacity describes remaining device-data storage in the stated terabyte unit.
native_findings.standing: Optional Boolean capability and storage quantity; no runtime proof
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Control readback, setpoint and direction
native_findings.native_meaning: ControlSignal reports readback, while Setpoint expresses a target. Analog control additionally identifies actuator kind and operating direction; discrete variants retain their state representations. A target does not prove the physical effect occurred.
native_findings.standing: Normative signal/variable structures; detailed discrete-variable definitions pending
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Authorized reset and adjustment requests
native_findings.native_meaning: FactoryReset selects application, communication or full reset scopes. ZeroPointAdjustment initiates a device-specific cycle; AutoAdjustPositioner starts or aborts manufacturer-specific commissioning. Access is restricted; method acceptance is not proof of completion or calibration quality.
native_findings.standing: Normative method contracts; no device execution
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Measurand, matrix and chemical identity
native_findings.native_meaning: The selected measurand belongs to a matrix of possible quantities. Dictionary discriminator, identifier and descriptive label carry different roles; CAS, PAT and user-defined terms are not interchangeable authority levels.
native_findings.standing: Optional analytical metadata and normative structured datatype
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Totalizer pulse scaling and width
native_findings.native_meaning: Pulse quantity associates mass or actual volume with a pulse; pulse width has a separate fixed time unit. Quantity-specific dictionary entries and units must survive mapping; pulse width is not pulse repetition interval.
native_findings.standing: Mandatory type properties with quantity-specific constraints
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: External conformance boundary
native_findings.native_meaning: The document delegates profiles and conformance units to an online database. Category labels and source declarations alone do not demonstrate full external conformance requirements or certification.
native_findings.standing: External reference; detailed profile originals pending
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Temperature sensing configuration has separate roles
native_findings.native_meaning: SensorType distinguishes RTD material/resistance or thermocouple material/type code and is mandatory within this variable type; optional SensorClass selects the connected sensing-element kind, SensorConnection describes RTD wire count, and SensorReference describes a thermocouple reference junction. SensorType dictionary reference depends on the sensing technology. None is a serial identity or observation value.

native_findings.native_meaning: LowFlowCutOff is a mandatory threshold expressed as percent of measuring span; prose gives a default tied to the EURange high value. Optional FlowDirection configures the sign used for forward flow. Neither describes a measured direction vector or valve state. Preserve the source wording about span/high value rather than inventing a nonzero-range formula.

native_findings.contact: Remaining text read and reconciled with original; targeted model/sheet evidence recorded in remaining_text_review

native_findings.title: Failure replacement output is distinct from fault status
native_findings.native_meaning: FaultState supplies an optional replacement output value on failure, Boolean or multistate according to the control variable. native_findings.contact: Remaining text read and reconciled with original; targeted model/sheet evidence recorded in remaining_text_review

native_findings.title: Operating-condition and normalized process quantities
native_findings.native_meaning: Distinguish mass flow, actual volume flow, volume flow calculated to base conditions, density under operating conditions, pressure and process-material level. A common numeric/unit representation does not establish equivalence between actual and normalized volume. These are quantity semantics, not necessarily separate master rows.
